@'
import ast
import json
from contextlib import nullcontext
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace

path = Path(r'token-master-plugin\skills\token-master\brainspace\optimizer.py')
tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
cls = next(n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.ClassDef) and n.name == 'Optimizer')
method = next(n for n in cls.body if isinstance(n, ast.FunctionDef) and n.name == 'learning_inventory')
namespace = {'json': json, 'COMPLETE': 'complete'}
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=[method], type_ignores=[]), str(path), 'exec'), namespace)
runs = [dict(run_id=name, kind='confirmation', state=state, expected_tasks_json='[]') for name, state in [('sealed', 'sealed'), ('open', 'open'), ('failed', 'failed')]]
traces = [SimpleNamespace(learning_run_id=name) for name in ['sealed', 'open', 'failed', 'missing', None]]
class DB:
    def execute(self, query, args=()):
        if 'opt_learning_runs' in query:
            return runs
        return SimpleNamespace(fetchall=lambda: [dict(event_id=i, records_json=t) for i, t in enumerate(traces)])
failed = {'failed_evaluations': [object()], 'known_partial_reference_tokens': 17}
owner = SimpleNamespace(_transaction=lambda: nullcontext(DB()), _trace=lambda t: t, _check_trace_ownership=lambda *args: None, _failed_evaluations=lambda db: failed)
method = namespace['learning_inventory']
original = method(owner)
assert method(owner, sealed_only=False) == original
filtered = method(owner, sealed_only=True)
assert filtered['runs'] == [original['runs'][0]]
assert filtered['traces'] == [traces[0]]
assert all(filtered[k] is v for k, v in failed.items())
runs.clear()
assert method(owner, sealed_only=True)['traces'] == []
assert method(owner, sealed_only=True)['runs'] == []
try:
    method(owner, True)
except TypeError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('sealed_only must be keyword-only')
print('Focused sealed-only checks passed')
'@ | python -; git --no-pager diff --check; git --no-pager status --short; git --no-pager diff --stat
